finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful advantage remains unresolved against every primary rival under both interval methods, with all primary intervals including zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods; residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both, with every residual interval including zero. Raw sums exclude useful base advantage under both methods and perform worse than base at zero only under writer resampling. Raw pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with all their intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Repeated selected model text adds training passes, not personal evidence. Suggestion supply and selection provenance, sparse histories, fixed donor/global training, shared exposed units and changed corpus support preclude epoch/backbone/corpus rankings, independent human confirmation, population limits, private-goal inference or a whole-matrix verdict. Historical failures and unknown attempts stay separate; no new retry.
